messages:
Carla: Hey team — first day on Sales! Quick wins: I can't access HubSpot (403 on contact lists) and Outreach shows no license. Also trying to join the demo recording folder in Gong but no access. Can someone point me to who to ping for licenses and the Sales playbook link?

Ben S: Welcome Carla!! :tada: Ping Alia for HubSpot/Outreach and IT for the Gong perms. I added you to my calendar for a 1:1 shadow at 3pm. Do you need the SDR or AE playbook?

Carla: Thanks Ben — AE playbook please. Also got an Okta prompt but it errors out after SSO.

Alia (Sales Ops): Hi Carla — I'll spin up a HubSpot seat and Outreach license. Can you DM me your preferred email? For Okta SSO error, IT likely needs to re-provision your session. I can escalate.

IT Support: Hey @Carla — we saw an invalid SAML assertion on the Okta logs for your account. Try clearing cookies or opening an incognito window and re-run the SSO. If it still fails, reply here and we'll force rebind your Okta profile.

Carla: Tried incognito, still 500 SAML error. DMing my email now.

onboarding-bot: Note: New hire checklist updated — HubSpot seat pending (Sales Ops), Outreach license pending (Sales Ops), Gong folder access pending (IT Support), AE playbook added to Notion onboarding page.

Alia (Sales Ops): Got your email — assigning HubSpot seat now. Outreach requires a license transfer; Emma (RevOps) owns the pool. @Emma can you free up one for Carla?

Emma (RevOps): On it — I can recycle an unused Outreach license from an alumni seat. Will confirm in 10–15m. Also dropping the AE playbook and a short battle-card pack here: https://notion.redwood/sales/playbooks/ae-onboarding (internal).

Jordan (CS): FWIW when you get Gong access, enable auto-transcribe and link it to your Gmail so recordings attach to contact records. If you want, shadow my demo at 11:30 tomorrow — I can annotate call notes in HubSpot so you see lifecycle tags.

Carla: Perfect, thanks everyone. Quick follow-ups: any must-read collateral for first week (one-pager + pricing cheat sheet)?

Alia (Sales Ops): Must reads: 1) AE playbook (Notion link above), 2) pricing cheat sheet (attached in Notion), 3) 2-pager on Dedicated vs Private deployments (shareable collateral), 4) battle-card highlighting cost/perf differentiators. I'll DM the attachments.

Ben S: Great — plan for today: get accounts working, review playbook, join my 3pm shadow. Tomorrow: listen to Jordan's demo and do a roleplay after. Ping me for any blockers. :+1:

Carla: Thanks all — will update here when HubSpot/Outreach/Gong are green.
